title: Health Avatar and Mana Tree
tagline: Be healthy, and get rewarded in other ecosystems, dapps, and networks... and we build a test 3rd party network to reward you
description:
1Problem: being healthy is hard. We need 30+ minutes of heart rate zone 3 or above per day, sleep 6-8 hours, drink 80oz + of water per day, eat non processed foods and get an array of nutrients

Problem 2: being motivated to be heaalthy is difficult. Fitness clubs have a turn over rate of 50% per year, and most people quit working out after some time. We find rewards, and accountability to be a great motivator. 

Solution: be rewarded in other ecosystems for being healthy. Kinda like how health insurance companies give you $$ when you go to the fitness club. Our hack is two parts.

Solution part 1: first, we made a mobile app that takes your apple health kit data and saves it to an NFT that represents your public facing health on chain (someday to be a soul bound token). You can take this NFT to other communities and ecosystems and be rewarded. 

Solution part 2: we created a test dapp called tree of mana, to represent a 3rd party ecosystem.  In the imaginary scenario, I'd like my wife to continue being healthy after I die, so I'll haunt her with this dapp even after I pass away. The dapp is an NFT tree, that represents Van, that requires you to 'water it", if you don't water it, it will die. And everytime you water it, it reveals a message I pre-recorded.   BUT in order to unlock the watering ability, you need to be healthy.
how_its_made: This projects uses flutter/dart for the mobile app that uses apple health kit to store your health data onto an NFT. The app uses Tatum to generate a wallet. We then have a dapp built in React that lets you use your health NFT to "water" a tree. We have an instance running on polygon, ethereum, and optimism test nets. For the image assets, we store on IPFS.
